1. (Currently Amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and flange member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; __at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler, wherein the composite fabric layer is applied as a post-cure reinforcement after initial composite tape layup__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric.

2. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the fabric layer covers the radius areas, __wherein the fabric layer is applied as a post-cure reinforcement distinct from the laminated composite tape plies__.

3. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a folded sheet of structural adhesive __applied after the composite fabric layer is positioned__.

4. (Original) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric includes graphite fibers held in an epoxy matrix.

5. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas, __and wherein the composite fabric layer is applied as a post-cure reinforcement__.

6. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other, __wherein the offset is created by selective placement of post-cure fabric reinforcement layers__.

7. (Currently Amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base, __wherein the composite fabric layer is applied as a post-cure reinforcement after initial composite tape layup__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer.

8. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein each of the composite channels and the base includes laminated composite tape with unidirectional reinforcing fibers, __and wherein the composite fabric layer is applied as a post-cure reinforcement distinct from the laminated composite tape__.

9. (Original) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes woven bidirectional reinforcing fibers.

10. (Original) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the bidirectional reinforcing fibers are graphite.

11. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the filler is one of: a formed unidirectional composite tape, a composite laminate, a hybrid tape-fabric member, __or__ a titanium member.

12. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes three composite patches respectively on each of the channels and the base, __wherein the patches are applied as post-cure reinforcement__.

13. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler, __wherein the adhesive sheet is applied after the composite fabric layer is positioned__.

14. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive extends beyond the radius filler zone into interfacial layers between the channels and between the base and each of the flanges, __wherein the extended adhesive layer is applied as part of the post-cure reinforcement process__.

15. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the channels are C-shaped, __and wherein the composite fabric layer is applied as a post-cure reinforcement__.

16. (Currently Amended) A method of fabricating a composite stiffener, comprising: forming a pair of composite channels each having a flange and a radius portion, using composite fiber tape; placing a layer of composite fiber fabric over the radius portion of each of the channels __after the composite tape layup is completed__; forming a base using composite fiber tape; __placing a reinforcing filler in at least a portion of the base__; placing a layer of adhesive around a filler; assembling the channels, the base and the filler in a radius filler zone between the radius portions of the channels and the base; and, curing the assembly.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 16, wherein the forming of the channels includes laying up unidirectional reinforcing fibers, __and wherein the composite fiber fabric is placed as a post-cure reinforcement__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 16, wherein placing the adhesive includes wrapping the filler with a sheet of adhesive, __wherein the adhesive sheet is applied after the composite fiber fabric is positioned__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 16, further comprising: placing a layer of composite fiber fabric on surfaces of each of the C-channels, the base and the cap outside the radius filler zone; and, introducing a layer of adhesive between the layers of composite fiber fabric on the sections outside the radius filler zone, __wherein the fabric layers outside the radius filler zone are applied as post-cure reinforcement__.

20. (Currently Amended) A method of fabricating a reinforced composite stiffener, comprising: forming a composite structure having a web and a pair of flanges extending in opposite directions from the web, __using laminated composite tape plies__; __applying a layer of composite fabric to radius areas between the laminated composite tape plies in an area between the web and the flanges, wherein the fabric layer is applied as a post-cure reinforcement__; joining a surface of the cap to the flanges; applying a layer of composite fabric to the surface of the cap joined to the flanges; placing a reinforcing filler between the web, the flanges and the cap; and, using an adhesive to join the reinforcing filler to the composite fabric layers on the composite structure and the cap.

21. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 20, wherein: forming the composite structure includes forming the laminated tape plies into first and second channels, and applying a layer of composite fabric over the laminated composite tape plies includes placing patches of the composite fabric on selected areas of the first and second channels, __wherein the fabric patches are applied as post-cure reinforcement__.

22. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21, further comprising: placing a layer of composite fabric on facing surfaces of each of the first and second channels __as post-cure reinforcement__; introducing an adhesive between the layers of composite fabric on the facing surfaces of the first and second channels; and, joining the first and second channels together at the facing surfaces.

23. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 20, wherein using an adhesive to join the reinforcing filler to the composite fabric layers includes wrapping a layer of structural adhesive around the filler, __wherein the adhesive layer is applied after the composite fabric layers are positioned__.

24. (Currently Amended) A method of fabricating a reinforced composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: forming multi-ply lay-ups of unidirectional composite tape; forming the lay-ups into first and second C-channels, a cap and a base; assembling the C-channels, the cap and the base into an I-section structure having a web and a pair of flanges on each end of the web; applying composite fabric to surfaces of the C-channels, the cap and the base in areas forming radius filler zones at the intersection of the web with the cap and with the base, __wherein the composite fabric is applied as a post-cure reinforcement after the initial composite tape layup__; wrapping a reinforcing filler with a structural adhesive; placing the reinforcing filler and the adhesive in the radius filler zone; and curing the assembly.

25. (Currently Amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape with a web and flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a pair of composite channels __and a cap and base__, including radius areas between the web and the flanges and __between the web and the cap and base__; the cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; __a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels, cap and base, wherein the composite fabric layer is applied as a post-cure reinforcement after initial composite tape layup__; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and __a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone, wherein the adhesive layer is applied after the composite fabric layer is positioned__.
